name: mos-mcp
description: Bridge Claude to broadcast newsroom systems over the MOS protocol: query media objects, build and send running orders, search object databases, and read from a live NCS.
long_description: mos-mcp connects the MOS (Media Object Server) protocol used by broadcast newsroom systems (ENPS, iNEWS, video servers, graphics) to the Model Context Protocol. It can act as a MOS client, a MOS device, or both, and exposes MOS Profiles 0-4 as tools. Runs entirely on your own network; it only talks to the MOS peers you configure.

config_path.title: Config file
config_path.description: Optional path to a mos-mcp YAML config file defining peers, role and profiles. Leave blank to configure peers from the admin console instead.

role.title: Role
role.description: client (dial out to MOS peers), device (listen for a newsroom system), or both.

mos_id.title: MOS ID
mos_id.description: How this bridge identifies itself on the MOS network (e.g. bridge.yourstation.com).

ncs_id.title: NCS ID
ncs_id.description: The newsroom-system identifier this bridge uses (e.g. newsroom.yourstation.com).

web_enabled.title: Enable admin console
web_enabled.description: Serve the loopback admin console (http://127.0.0.1:8088) for managing peers.

tools.name: mos_status
tools.description: Bridge identity, peers, connection state and inbox size.

tools.name: mos_add_peer
tools.description: Register an outbound MOS peer to connect to.

tools.name: mos_remove_peer
tools.description: Unregister a MOS peer and close its connections.

tools.name: mos_heartbeat
tools.description: Verify a peer connection is alive.

tools.name: mos_request_machine_info
tools.description: Query a peer's identity and supported profiles.

tools.name: mos_inbox
tools.description: Recent messages received while acting as a MOS device.

tools.name: mos_send_raw
tools.description: Send an arbitrary MOS XML message to a peer.

tools.name: mos_request_object
tools.description: Fetch a single media object description by ID.

tools.name: mos_request_all_objects
tools.description: Fetch descriptions of all media objects from a peer.

tools.name: mos_create_running_order
tools.description: Create a running order with stories and items.

tools.name: mos_replace_running_order
tools.description: Replace the contents of a running order.

tools.name: mos_delete_running_order
tools.description: Delete a running order by ID.

tools.name: mos_element_action
tools.description: Insert, replace, move, swap or delete running-order elements.

tools.name: mos_ready_to_air
tools.description: Signal whether a running order is ready to air.

tools.name: mos_send_story
tools.description: Send the full body of a single story to a peer.

tools.name: mos_request_all_running_orders
tools.description: List running orders known to a peer.
